Hackensack BullsBrewster’s MillionsA fortune to burn, fast. Start with dinner.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersShrimp CocktailSix, poached and chilled, on shredded iceberg with rosy tomato mayonnaise, lemon and paprika.Passed through the box seats all night.How to make it500g green prawns1 lemon, halved1 bay leaf4 tbsp mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1/2 iceberg lettuce, shredded1 tsp smoked paprikaPoach the prawns in salted water with the lemon and bay leaf, then plunge into iced water and peel.Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and a squeeze of lemon.Serve on shredded iceberg in glasses, with sauce and a dusting of paprika.Red Caviar BliniBuckwheat pancakes, crème fraîche, salmon roe, chives.Made to order. Allow twenty minutes.How to make it16 buckwheat blinis150ml crème fraîche100g salmon roe1 bunch chives, snippedWarm the blini on a tray at 180°C.Top each with crème fraîche, then salmon roe and chives.Serve straight away while warm.MainsSurf and TurfAn eight ounce filet mignon seared to order and a lobster tail grilled in garlic butter. Béarnaise.The most expensive thing on the card. Thirty even.How to make it60ml white wine vinegar1 bunch tarragon3 egg yolks250g butter, clarified and kept warm4 eye fillet steaks2 lobster tails2 garlic cloves, crushedReduce the vinegar with the tarragon to a few spoonfuls.Whisk with the yolks over low heat and drizzle in 200g of the warm clarified butter for the béarnaise.Sear the steaks to medium rare, then rest.Split the lobster tails and brush with garlic butter made from the remaining butter.Grill the lobster until cooked through.Plate the steak with lobster and sauce.SweetsPostage StampsPinked butter shortbread, each iced like a stamp. Six.Iced like the real thing. Do not mail.How to make it250g butter200g icing sugar250g plain flour60g rice flourBeat the butter with half the icing sugar, then mix in the flours.Roll to 6mm and cut into rectangles with a pinking cutter.Bake at 160°C until pale.Cool completely.Mix the rest of the icing sugar with a drop of water and pipe a little stamp design on each.DrinksChampagne CocktailA sugar cube soaked in bitters, orange liqueur, chilled brut to the brim and a twist of peel.The whole bar, on Monty.How to make it4 sugar cubes8 dashes of aromatic bitters60ml orange liqueur480ml chilled brut champagne1 orange, for peelDrop a sugar cube into each of 4 flutes and shake bitters onto each.Add orange liqueur to each glass.Top slowly with champagne.Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
